{/* Story */}

Our Story

EventHub started as a university project with a simple observation: finding events in Beirut was scattered across dozens of Instagram pages, WhatsApp groups, and word-of-mouth. There had to be a better way.

Built using modern web technologies — React, Tailwind CSS, and React Router — EventHub is a fully responsive, frontend-only application that demonstrates how powerful a well-designed single-page app can be without any backend infrastructure.

What started as an academic exercise grew into a fully functional prototype that could realistically serve as the foundation for a production-ready event management platform.
